Which data sources can be utilized with Apache Spark SQL?

Apache Spark SQL supports a variety of data sources through the DataFrame interface

Here are some of the key data sources you can utilize with Apache Spark SQL:

CSV Files: Load and save data in comma-separated values format
.

JSON Files: Load and save data in JavaScript Object Notation format
.

Parquet Files: Load and save data in Parquet format, which is optimized for columnar storage
.

ORC Files: Load and save data in Optimized Row Columnar format
.

Text Files: Load and save plain-text files2
.

Hive Tables: Read and write data stored in Apache Hive tables
.

JDBC/ODBC Connections: Connect to and interact with other databases using JDBC or ODBC connections2
.

Avro Files: Load and save data in Avro format
.

Protobuf Files: Load and save data in Protocol Buffers format
.

These data sources allow you to perform a wide range of data processing and analysis tasks using Spark SQL1
.
